_comment: Channel config for run_po.py. 'expects' = which files the channel sends: 'pdf+sheet', 'pdf' or 'sheet'. The pipeline is chosen from the files actually received; 'expects' only guards against a wrong upload. A channel not listed here uses 'default' (no 'expects' check). Optional per channel: 'pipeline' ('flat_csv' = one-row-per-item csv, handled by extract_flat_csv.py, with 'header_columns' listing the PO-level columns, [] when the file has none, and optional 'filename_fields' = {'pattern': regex with one group per field, 'fields': [field names]} for PO fields found only in the file name) and 'header_notes' (layout hints added to the header prompt, PDF-only and PDF + sheet channels). PDF + sheet only: 'pdf_totals' = {header field: line-item column}, totals printed in the PDF checked against the column sums. 'read_last_page': true also sends the PDF's last page to the model, for totals printed at the end. PDF-only layout switches, off unless set: 'split_value_rate_cells' (cells like '545.51 (9.000%)' become an amount column and a '<name> Rate' column) and 'unlabeled_total_row' (a numbers-only row after the items is the Total row). 'stacked_table' = {'first_header': first heading cell of the items table, 'totals': {total row label: column or [columns]}}: items whose cells stack several values (one per line, matching the heading's lines) are read straight from the text layer with no model call, and each total row is checked against its column sums.

myntra.description: Stock Transfer Request PDF + line-items csv

slikk.description: PDF PO (header, printed totals) + xlsx with the line items; the xlsx totals must match the PDF's
slikk.header_notes:
- Return EXACTLY these field names (and no others) when the value is printed: 'PO Number' (the value after 'PO#', e.g. SLIKPO#550; the title 'PURCHASE ORDER #550' is not a separate field), 'Nature Of Supply', 'Nature of Transaction', 'PO Expiry Date', 'Category', 'PO Date' (printed as ORDER DATE), 'Buyer Name' (printed as Company Name), 'Buyer Registered Address' (the 'Registered Address' at the top), 'Supplier Name', 'Brand Name', 'Model', 'Billed By Name', 'Billed By GSTIN', 'Billed By State Code', 'Shipped From Address', 'Billed To Address', 'Billed To GSTIN', 'Billed To State Code', 'Shipped To Address', 'Mode Of Payment', 'Credit Term', 'Total Quantity', 'Taxable Value', 'Tax Amount', 'Total Amount'. - The top row of boxes reads: PO# | Nature Of Supply | Nature of Transaction | PO Expiry, then CATEGORY | ORDER DATE | Company Name. Each value sits in the box right after its label and may wrap onto two lines: 'Nature Of Supply' is 'FOB Purchase' (two words, both belong to it) and 'Nature of Transaction' is 'NEFT'. Never use a word of one value as part of the next label. - 'Model' is printed with the value 'OR' — return it as printed. - 'MODE OF PAYMENT' is 'Mode Of Payment' (e.g. NEFT) and 'CREDIT TERM' is 'Credit Term' (e.g. 30 days); never return either as 'Payment Terms'. - Never use the names PO Type, Payment Terms, Vendor, Delivered To or Delivered By. - The 'Shipped From' cell is wrapped in stray HTML tags ('

' ... '

'). Leave the tags out, but keep ALL the text between them, including the 'Building No./Flat No.:', 'Name Of Premises/Building:', 'Road/Street:' etc. labels, as ONE value named 'Shipped From Address'. Do not split out a name. - The summary box above the items table prints 'Taxable Value', 'Tax Amount', 'Total Amount' and 'Total Quantity = '. Return them with values copied as printed (e.g. '564633.75 INR'). Ignore the repeated 'Total = ...' row. - Fields printed as '-' (Supplier Contact, Email, Approval Details) have no value: omit them.

gluzo.description: PDF PO (header; totals on the last page) + xlsx with the line items on the first sheet (the second sheet is a SKU lookup and is not read)
gluzo.header_notes:
- Return EXACTLY these field names (and no others), each only when a value is printed:
  'PO Number' (the number under 'PURCHASE ORDER' at the top right, e.g. 1974519),
  'Buyer Name', 'Buyer Address', 'Buyer Phone', 'Buyer GSTIN' (the company block at the top; its GSTIN is printed as 'GST number'),
  'Vendor Code', 'Vendor Name', 'Vendor Address', 'Contact Person', 'Contact Number', 'Vendor GSTIN' (printed as 'Vendor Tax ID'),
  'PO Ref No', 'PO Date', 'Payment Term', 'Expected Delivery Date', 'Vendor Invoice Number', 'Purchase Date', 'Payment Mode',
  'Billing Name', 'Billing Address', 'Billing Phone', 'Shipping Name', 'Shipping Address', 'Shipping Phone',
  'Total Quantity', 'Item Total', 'Total Tax Amount', 'Grand Total', 'Value In Words'.
- The vendor block (left) and the PO fields (right: PO Ref No, PO Date, Payment Term, Expected Delivery Date, Vendor Invoice Number, Vendor Tax ID, Purchase Date, Payment Mode) sit side by side. Several right-hand labels have NO value — omit them; never give one label the value of the next label or of the vendor block.
- 'Vendor Address' is the lines under the vendor name, joined (street, city, state - pin, country).
- Billing Address (left) and Shipping Address (right) each start with a company name line: return it as 'Billing Name' / 'Shipping Name', the street lines as 'Billing Address' / 'Shipping Address', and the phone line as 'Billing Phone' / 'Shipping Phone'.
- The totals are on the LAST page, under the items table: 'Item Total' prints a quantity and an amount — return the quantity as 'Total Quantity' (e.g. 528) and the amount as 'Item Total' (e.g. ₹178802.24*). Return 'Total Tax Amount', 'Grand Total' and 'Value In Words' as printed, including the ₹ sign and the trailing '*'.
- Ignore the line-items table, the terms and conditions and the signature block.

purple.description: SAP PDF PO, line items read from the PDF

avenue.description: PDF PO, line items read from the PDF — each line item printed on two rows
avenue.header_notes:
- The header has three boxes side by side: Vendor (left edge), Bill To (middle) and Ship To (right). Each box's lines belong to that box only.
- The Vendor box ends with its own 'Email ID' and 'GST #' lines at the LEFT EDGE: the first 'GST #' (at the left edge) is the VENDOR's GSTIN — return it as 'Vendor GSTIN', never as the buyer's.
- The Ship To box ends with its own 'Email ID' and 'GST #' lines, indented under 'Ship To': that 'GST #' is the Ship To GSTIN — return it as 'Ship To GSTIN'.
- No buyer GSTIN is printed in the header; do not return a 'Buyer GSTIN' field.
- The number printed next to 'Purchase Order' in the title line is the PO Number.
- The 'Corp Off:' line under the title, ABOVE the three boxes, is the buyer company's (the one named in the title) — return its values as 'Buyer Corporate Office Address', 'Buyer Tel Number' and 'Buyer CIN', never as Bill To fields.
- 'PO Validity' is ONE field, copied exactly as printed (e.g. '16.09.2026 to 31.10.2026') — do not split it into start and end dates.

reliance.description: SAP PDF PO: header on page 1, items table with several values stacked in each cell (read by rule, no model), terms pages after
reliance.header_notes:
- The header is on PAGE 1 only. Ignore the terms & conditions pages and the 'Annexure For Site Details' table.
- Return EXACTLY these field names (and no others), each only when a value is printed:
  'Buyer Name', 'Buyer Address' (the company block at the very top, e.g. Reliance Retail Limited and its address),
  'Vendor Code', 'Vendor Name', 'Vendor Address', 'Vendor Email', 'Vendor PAN', 'Vendor Status', 'Vendor GSTIN', 'Attention' (the SELLER box on the left),
  'PO Number', 'Site', 'PO Date' (the box on the right: 'PO NO.: 5000502101 Site : SBIQ' is TWO fields, PO Number and Site),
  'Site Name' (the bold heading above the terms paragraph, e.g. RRL Beauty Bangalore DC),
  'Delivery Address', 'Delivery Tel', 'Delivery GSTIN', 'Delivery Email' (the Delivery Address box; the address starts right after 'Delivery Address :' and ends with the pin code),
  'Delivery Date', 'Payment Terms', 'Delivery Term',
  'Buyer Contact Name', 'Buyer Contact Email' (printed as 'Buyer :' and 'Email :' at the bottom),
  'Registered Office Address', 'CIN',
  'TOTAL BASIC VALUE', 'TOTAL IGST', 'Total Order Value' (values without the 'INR' label, e.g. '123,614.63').
- 'Vendor Address' is the lines between the vendor name and 'E-Mail', joined, including the 'Pin Code : ...' line.
- Never use the names Delivered To, Ship To, Bill To or Supplier.
